why_you_went.text: You went to the ER because you had a headache for several days, neck pain, tingling in your left hand, and an abnormal heart tracing at urgent care.

findings.name: CT and CT angiogram of your head and neck
findings.result: Normal. No blocked blood vessels, aneurysm, or artery tear was found.

findings.name: Neurologic exam
findings.result: Normal except for slightly different sensation in your left palm.

findings.name: Blood tests
findings.result: The ER doctor described them as unremarkable.

findings.name: Heart tracing
findings.result: It showed a right bundle branch block and first-degree AV block, but the ER doctor did not think it showed a heart attack or other acute loss of blood flow to the heart.

disposition.text: They did not find an emergency cause for your symptoms, and you were discharged in stable condition.

next_steps.text: Schedule a primary-care appointment to follow up on the headache, hand tingling, and abnormal heart tracing.

none_statement.text: You were not prescribed any new medicines.

return_precautions.text: Return to the ER if you develop any new or worsening symptoms.
